title: Descriptive evaluation of students using fuzzy approximate reasoning
benchmark_measurement: Not applicable. The paper does not measure any aspect of faith or religion.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion. Its focus is on a fuzzy logic-based student evaluation system for mathematics in Iran.
